text:
Maya: Quick decision — launch day in 9 days. Pause weekly newsletter that week or run both? Need a short thumbs by EOD.
Priya: pause. run a compact 3-email launch drip to engaged users only.
Sam: agree. also run a 2-email re-engage to low-engagement segment and prune long-term inert addresses after.
Evan: can ops surface counts for Active/Warm/Cold by EOD? need send volume estimate.
ops: will run export. prelim numbers: total subscribed ~315k, active (30d) ~88k, warm (30-90d) ~32k, cold ~195k.
Priya: re-engage plan: Day0 subject test A/B (product update vs benchmark highlights), Day4 follow-up. If no opens after 30d -> tag `pruned_launch_2026`.
Sam: test send windows 10am local vs 3pm local for warm cohort. track opens by region.
Maya: exclude customers, trials <365d, webinar RSVPs, and anyone with snooze_opt_out.
marketing-bot: Campaign created: "march_launch_sweep_2026" id: cm_2026_march_sweep — assets pending.
Maya: action items: Priya finalize subjects by tomorrow 11am; Evan/ops deliver suppression CSV by tomorrow EOD; Sam wire A/B splits. If no objections, we proceed.
Priya: dropping subject options in doc now.
Sam: good to go from me.
Evan: starting export job.
